mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UB_MENTEE_BOARD (board_title, board_content, member_number) VALUES (#{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{memberNumber})
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_id AS memberId, b.menteeboard_number AS menteeBoardNumber, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, DATE_FORMAT(b.board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, b.board_click AS boardClick FROM UB_MEMBER m JOIN UB_MENTEE_BOARD b ON b.member_number = m.member_number WHERE b.menteeboard_number = #{menteeBoardNumber}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.board_date DESC) AS rnum, m.member_number AS memberNumber, m.member_id AS memberId, b.menteeboard_number AS menteeBoardNumber, b.board_title AS boardTitle, b.board_content AS boardContent, DATE_FORMAT(b.board_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS boardDate, b.board_click AS boardClick FROM UB_MEMBER m JOIN UB_MENTEE_BOARD b ON m.member_number = b.member_number ) paged WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
